subject.title: refactor(config): consolidate session and channel regression fixtures

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled test consolidation be rebased and merged after a complete current-main review, or should the session/config owners request further narrowing?
rationale: Repository policy prevents automatic cleanup of protected-label items, and the complete source/history pass could not run in this sandbox.

options.title: Rebase and complete owner review
options.body: Refresh the branch against current `main` and verify the full fixture refactor preserves the prior regression matrix before merging.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Split any difficult-to-review fixture consolidation from the three new owner-level regression cases if a focused review shows the combined patch obscures behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase and complete owner review
